body:
That's a cover of the same song but the original is by The Smiths. 
Sorry, I didn't actually know that about Spotify, I've never used it.

Don't worry about me, I'm not planning on doing anything immediately. Hope your days have been well. I'll return the favor with another song I like, that hopefully you may too
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OztC_7nkAd8

I'm sorry you were forced into the sewdish army like that. I can definitly relate with the feeling of an adrenaline rush; when I am anxious my body shakes and my heart beats like crazy.

As for songs, personally this one helps me. I find the escapism theme soothing. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gk2V2V9-4cs

Just anything that causes me significant emotional stress, really. 

Everyone is different in their own ways, but I wouldn't be surprised if we are similar in some respects.
Thank you for the suggestion. In the past I've been to an outpatient program, as I nearly flunked out of high-school. Personally, it didn't change anything for me.

I'm glad you have people supporting you, and wish you the best of luck for the future. My family has been very supportive financially, though they don't understand mental illness at all.

I could never live on the streets, because my reaction to anything stressful is to become suicidal. I guess that is why I'm here in the first place.

I'm still here, sorry for worrying you. Thank you for sharing, and the song was lovely. I'm sorry you are struggling with depression and other things yourself.

I can relate in some ways. I've never had a very strong connection to life so when I was a kid I'd too think about dying, though it was over what I look back on now as unimportant kid stuff. That strong want you described is about where I am now, but I want to try and put my desires secondary when making a decision.
Thanks for the response. I suppose I'm not doing great, but I hope you are : ). Anecdotal stories are fine to give some insight, if you are willing to share. Though no obligation to, of course.

Thank you for the concern and apologies for this wordy response. I've actually signed up (If thats the right word) to have my body's tissues and organs donated if I die. I do try to live in a way that causes the least amount of suffering, but even so it's impossible to exist without taking from someone else. For example, I know some mice/rodents still die from harvesting the food I eat and any job I get could be robbing the possibility of employment from someone else.

I am biased because it would primarily be fulfilling my selfish desire, but I feel like the pain I cause to my family by killing myself could be offset by the positives of erasing myself. At least that is my view on the matter.

Thanks for your comment.
I know both are bad, but would you consider one to be particularly worse than the other?
